functions.purpose: Binary TDR WRITE serializer for a 58-field pet attribute struct. For each field it writes the field tag (FUN_1010c5f0), advances 4 bytes for a length placeholder (FUN_1010bf70), serializes a nested 'observed value' sub-struct (FUN_101b0280 -> sub_101B0520 family), then backpatches the LEN_DELIM length (FUN_1010c3c0). All 58 fields are wire-type 5 (LEN_DELIM) nested sub-structs. Field-id count (58) matches TlvPetExtAttrData DebugFormat (58).

fields 18,19,20,21 (tags 0x125,0x135,0x145,0x155): wire5 LEN nested — names unknown
fields 23,24,25 (tags 0x175,0x185,0x195): wire5 LEN nested — names unknown
functions.tlvDocDiscrepancy: Generated TlvPetExtAttrData doc lists only the 5-field 0x99 subset and types the fields as plain int32 with wire3 tags (e.g. oPetName 0x43). Actual writer emits ALL 58 fields as wire5 (LEN_DELIM) nested sub-structs (oPetName tag 0x45, not 0x43). The 'oXxx' fields are nested observed-value wrappers (sub_101B0520), not scalar int32. Doc field count (5) vs real (58).
functions.serverRelevance: High. This is a real wire producer; a server rebuild must emit these 58 optional nested fields in field-id order with correct LEN_DELIM framing to be parsed by the client.
functions.notes: Uses TdrBuf primitives: FUN_1010c5f0=WriteTag, FUN_1010bf70=ReserveLenPlaceholder(+4), FUN_1010c3c0=BackpatchLen, FUN_101b0280=nested element serializer. Preamble reserves a 4-byte struct length prefix and asserts position<=length (TdrBuf.h:0x92).

functions.purpose: TDR write helper for a single 16-bit field with two encoding modes selected by param_5. Mode 0: writes variant marker 0x99 (FUN_1010c0c0), tag 0x12 (field 1, wire2=2B), then the uint16 big-endian into the output buffer (2 bytes). Mode 1: writes marker 0xaa, tag 0x10 (field1, wire0 varint) via FUN_1010c430. Returns bytes-written via param_4; returns -0x13 if dest buffer/len null.
protocolFields: field 1 (tag 0x12 mode0 / 0x10 mode1): int16 value, written big-endian (hi byte first) in 2B mode
functions.serverRelevance: High. Confirms 0x99 = NoVariant marker and shows the exact big-endian byte order (MSB first) the client expects for a wire2 int16 field; server must match this ordering.
functions.notes: 0x99/0xaa are TDR variant/head bytes. FUN_1010c0c0=WriteHead, FUN_1010c5f0=WriteTag, FUN_1010c430=WriteShortVarint. Big-endian encoding: *dst=(u>>8); dst[1]=(u&0xff).

Read counterpart of FUN_101ff870.
protocolFields: field 1: int16 @ +0 (big-endian on wire), presence bit 0x1 stored at +2
functions.serverRelevance: High. Shows how the client parses a single-int16 TLV incl. presence-flag bit and big-endian order; server must produce matching bytes.
functions.notes: Returns 0xfffffffe (-2) on truncated buffer, 0xffffffde on overrun. Skip path FUN_1010d4f0=SkipUnknownField.
